spec.description: TopoLVM capacity, thin pool, PVC usage, and component health dashboard.

spec.title: Thin Pool Metadata Used
spec.description: Thin pool metadata usage percent. Metadata exhaustion can fail thin volume operations even when data space remains.

spec.title: Overprovisioned Available
spec.description: Thin pool available bytes after applying TopoLVM overprovisioning rules.

spec.title: PVC Used Percent
spec.description: Filesystem usage percentage for mounted PVCs, collected from kubelet volume stats.

spec.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

spec.title: PVC Used and Capacity
spec.description: Used and capacity bytes for mounted PVCs, collected from kubelet volume stats.

spec.expr: kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

spec.title: PVC Inode Used Percent
spec.description: PVC inode usage percentage from kubelet volume stats.

spec.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"})

spec.title: Abnormal PVC Health
spec.description: PVCs reported as abnormal by kubelet volume health status.

spec.expr: kubelet_volume_stats_health_status_abnormal{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}) == 1

spec.title: PVCs
spec.description: PVC count for the selected storage class. Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.expr: count(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}) OR on() vector(0)

spec.title: PVC Phase
spec.description: PVC phase count for the selected storage class. Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))

spec.title: Managed Capacity
spec.description: Total LVM capacity managed by TopoLVM across selected nodes and device classes.

spec.title: Top PVC Usage
spec.description: PVCs with the highest filesystem usage percentage.

spec.expr: topk(10, 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))

spec.title: Scrape Targets Up
spec.description: Prometheus target availability for TopoLVM pods.

spec.title: Process Memory
spec.description: Memory usage for TopoLVM and lvmd processes, when process metrics are scraped.

spec.title: Process CPU
spec.description: CPU usage rate for TopoLVM and lvmd processes, when process metrics are scraped.

spec.title: Total Number Of Nodes
spec.description: Total Kubernetes nodes in the cluster. Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.title: Number Of TopoLVM Nodes
spec.description: Kubernetes nodes currently exporting TopoLVM volume group metrics.

spec.title: Number Of Ready TopoLVM Nodes
spec.description: TopoLVM nodes whose Kubernetes Ready condition is true. Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.expr: count((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} == 1) and on(node) count by (node) (topolvm_volumegroup_size_bytes)) OR on() vector(0)

spec.title: Available Capacity
spec.description: Free LVM capacity available for scheduling across selected nodes and device classes.

spec.title: Number Of Nodes Missing TopoLVM
spec.description: Kubernetes nodes that do not currently export TopoLVM volume group metrics.

spec.expr: count(kube_node_info unless on(node) count by (node) (topolvm_volumegroup_size_bytes)) OR on() vector(0)

spec.title: Node Capacity
spec.description: Current TopoLVM capacity by Kubernetes node and device class.

spec.title: Nodes Missing TopoLVM
spec.description: Kubernetes nodes that are present in the cluster but do not expose TopoLVM volume group metrics.

spec.title: Node Storage Usage
spec.description: Used TopoLVM volume group capacity percentage by node and device class.

spec.title: Number Of PVCs Per Namespace
spec.description: Mounted TopoLVM PVC count by namespace, filtered to StorageClasses provisioned by topolvm.io.

spec.expr: count by (namespace) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume"} * on(namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(storageclass) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$volume", storageclass=~"$storageclass"} * on(storageclass) group_left(provisioner) kube_storageclass_info{provisioner="topolvm.io", storageclass=~"$storageclass"}))

spec.title: TopoLVM Node Ready Status
spec.description: Ready condition for nodes that currently export TopoLVM metrics. Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.title: Capacity Used
spec.description: Percentage of managed LVM capacity currently unavailable.

spec.title: TopoLVM Nodes
spec.description: Number of nodes currently exporting TopoLVM volume group metrics.

spec.title: Volume Group Capacity
spec.description: Available and total capacity per node and device class.

spec.title: Volume Group Used Percent
spec.description: Used capacity percentage per node and device class.

spec.title: Thin Pool Data Used
spec.description: Thin pool data usage percent. Values near 100% indicate immediate risk for thin provisioned volumes.
